The live glyph has a rounded top return, an inward middle turn, and a lower-left turn ending in a horizontal base. Reader A initially favored Sigma, but the form also admits cursive E; the updated shared notation explicitly retains the same uncertainty at every occurrence. The subscript is the looped X with prime. The preferred E matches C, but C has ordinary X where the visible decorated subscript is encoded mathfrak X; therefore this composite locus remains against both witnesses.
